widgets_values:
The sound of a whole video, then the cut.

SOUND. WExtractor gives the frames of a small copy of the film (multiple on). WCutScene finds the cuts, WAudio Prompts writes a prompt per scene, WLoop Start Foley cuts the scenes into windows of at most 7 s. One Run: the For Loop makes every window with LTX-2.3 and the Foley V2A LoRA (LTX-2 Community License: say the audio is AI generated), and the mix is saved as flac.

CUT. WMount joins the clips of a folder into one film. In WMixer the flac of the loop is a track, next to the music and the voice: the timeline lives inside the node. WAonV puts the mix on the film picked in its menu, without encoding the picture again.

Model, video and audio names are examples: pick your own.
